In this video we cover:
China’s Global Debt Trap: The Hidden $800 Billion Crisis
This story explains how China has secretly lent over $800 billion to developing countries through strict, collateral-backed loans under its Belt and Road Initiative. Many of these nations are now struggling to repay, raising fears of a global debt crisis like the one in the 1980s. We explore why China started this massive lending boom, how its loans work, why the momentum has now reversed, and what the world risks if China delays solving the growing debt problems.
